content.title: Housing and Other Assistance
content.summary: The Housing Choice Voucher Program provides rental payment assistance to very low-income households. For additional support, residents can access Human Services through Jefferson and Adams counties, with resources available on their respective websites.
content.body:
## Housing Choice Voucher Program

The Housing Choice Voucher Program assists in offering very low-income households vouchers to assist with rental payments. For more information about how to apply to be on the waiting list, please [visit the Housing Choice Voucher Program page](/438/Arvada-Housing-Authority---Housing-Choic).

## County Human Services

Human Services are provided by counties, including Jefferson and Adams counties. If you need assistance with Human Services, please refer to the resources below.

- Jefferson County Human Services - Please explore the [Jeffco Human Services website](https://www.jeffco.us/2184/Human-Services) for details on programs, resources, and more.
- Adams County Human Services - Please explore Adams County resources at [Adams County Human Services](http://www.adcogov.org/humanservices).
